name: mirage
text: Yes. The Novig ledger for the Vigilant subaccount goes back to the first fill, so the new rule can be recomputed for every past day and for all time. Each day (by game day, Eastern) will be the winnings paid minus the cost of the bets and bids on games that are final. Open bets and unfinished games stay out of every total and graph. Deposits and withdrawals aren't used at all. The one catch is that older bets with no result recorded yet are left out until they settle, so early days could shift a little. I've queued it as the next build, and it will also show where the ~$72 gap between the settled bets and the old all-time number came from.
